<thought>To obtain the template for the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) step, I will search the template catalog using only the target molecule SMILES, without specifying functional‑group filters that caused an error. This should return a suitable template (including its mapped_rxn and template_id) which I can then incorporate into the final retrosynthesis route JSON.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
  "functional_groups_broken": null,
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_formed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
